summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Athena Funding III LLC amended its Loan Financing and Servicing Agreement on September 11, 2026. The amendment raises the facility's maximum principal amount from $150 million to $250 million and revises borrowing base test conditions. Deutsche Bank AG, New York Branch, serves as facility agent, with State Street Bank and Trust Company as collateral agent and custodian. This is a routine credit-facility upsize for the BDC's financing subsidiary, not a special situation. Watch for increased leverage capacity and potential portfolio deployment.
